properties.name: firemud.presentation.default-locale-tag
properties.description: Default renderer locale tag used for built-in localized notice, error, and other platform text when no per-player preference overrides it.

properties.name: firemud.presentation.default-color-mode
properties.description: Default color/emphasis mode for the text renderer when no per-player presentation preference overrides it.

properties.name: firemud.presentation.brief-enabled-by-default
properties.description: Whether room-view rendering defaults to BRIEF-style suppression for movement-triggered and other suppressible output segments.

properties.name: firemud.presentation.prompt.enabled
properties.description: Whether prompt output is enabled by default for text-session rendering.

properties.name: firemud.presentation.prompt.emit-after-reconnect-restore
properties.description: Whether reconnect restore appends a fresh prompt after rendering bounded semantic reconnect context and a fresh LOOK.

properties.name: firemud.presentation.prompt.coalesce-window-ms
properties.description: Maximum prompt burst window, in milliseconds, used to suppress prompt spam while still retaining prompts for explicit boundary commands such as LOOK.

properties.name: firemud.reconnection.policy.resume-window-ms
properties.description: Maximum resume window, in milliseconds, before a stale gameplay binding is treated as non-resumable.

properties.name: firemud.reconnection.policy.stale-resume-falls-through-to-fresh-entry
properties.description: Whether a stale or invalid resumable binding should fall through to fresh entry when current admission still allows PLAY.

properties.name: firemud.reconnection.buffer.ttl-ms
properties.description: TTL, in milliseconds, for bounded semantic reconnect context retained for each canonical playable-character scope `{tenantId, playableStateNamespaceId, characterId}`; retention does not grant resume or replay authority.

properties.name: firemud.reconnection.buffer.max-entries
properties.description: Maximum complete entries retained in one durable bounded semantic reconnect context before oldest-entry eviction; retention does not grant resume or replay authority.

properties.name: firemud.reconnection.buffer.expiry-sweep.enabled
properties.description: Whether Game Session periodically removes expired durable semantic reconnect-context entries.

properties.name: firemud.reconnection.buffer.min-messages
properties.description: Best-effort minimum message floor for bounded semantic reconnect-context retention; subordinate to the absolute hard byte ceiling and never an override of it.

properties.name: firemud.reconnection.buffer.min-lines
properties.description: Best-effort minimum line floor for bounded semantic reconnect-context retention; subordinate to the absolute hard byte ceiling and never an override of it.

properties.name: firemud.reconnection.buffer.soft-max-bytes
properties.description: Best-effort soft byte preference for bounded semantic reconnect-context retention; message and line floors may be preserved where possible, but this preference is subordinate to the absolute hard ceiling.

properties.name: firemud.reconnection.buffer.hard-max-bytes
properties.description: Target hard byte ceiling for bounded semantic reconnect-context retention; it applies to each complete scope-bound persisted envelope and never permits an oversized entry to bypass the bound. Current runtime retains a single oversized entry, so omission/marker enforcement and proof remain implementation gaps.

properties.name: firemud.command-history.max-entries
properties.description: Maximum retained and displayable accepted command-history entries per player character; values are capped at 20.

properties.name: firemud.command-history.retention-sweep-ms
properties.description: Delay, in milliseconds, between bounded background sweeps that trim inactive player command histories to their current effective maximum.

properties.name: firemud.command-capabilities.social-enabled
properties.description: Whether standard social commands such as SAY, WHISPER, TELL, and FRIENDS are available by default.

properties.name: firemud.command-capabilities.presence-enabled
properties.description: Whether standard presence commands such as WHO are available by default.

properties.name: firemud.command-capabilities.inventory-enabled
properties.description: Whether standard inventory and equipment commands are available by default.

properties.name: firemud.command-capabilities.command-history-enabled
properties.description: Whether the player-facing HISTORY command is available by default.

properties.name: firemud.movement.post-move-look-enabled
properties.description: Whether a successful MOVE automatically renders the destination room view instead of returning only command acknowledgement.

properties.name: firemud.world-topology.scope-model
properties.description: The highest topology model the current game/runtime expresses for future scope-sensitive communication and world behaviors.

properties.name: firemud.world-topology.regions-enabled
properties.description: Whether explicit world regions are enabled in the current topology model.

values.description: Render plain text without ANSI color or emphasis.
Render basic ANSI color/emphasis where supported.
Render richer emphasis/color variants for capable clients.
World layout only distinguishes map-level scope.
World layout distinguishes areas within a map.
World layout distinguishes regions above areas and maps.
